persona.label: Loose-aggressive
persona.desc: Plays many hands and puts constant pressure on you with bets and raises.
persona.beat: Call down lighter with decent hands and let them bluff into your strong ones.

persona.label: Maniac
persona.desc: Raises and bluffs constantly, often with nothing.
persona.beat: Wait for good hands, then let them bet into you. Call more, bluff less.

persona.label: Casual
persona.desc: A recreational player: limps a lot, chases draws and chats.
persona.beat: Raise their limps, bet your made hands, and make draws pay.

persona.label: Cautious
persona.desc: Plays reasonable hands but gives up easily when someone bets.
persona.beat: Bet at pots they check. Believe them when they raise.

persona.label: Trapper
persona.desc: Slow-plays big hands and loves to check-raise.
persona.beat: Be careful when they suddenly wake up with a raise after checking.
